brief:
Israeli authorities are detaining activists and community organizers who attempt to protect Palestinian farmers during this year's olive harvest season, Human Rights Watch reported. The UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs has documented the current harvest as the most violent in its 20 years of records.

The arrests target those working to shield farmers from interference as they gather olives, according to the rights group.
dek: Israeli authorities are detaining activists and community organizers attempting to protect Palestinian farmers during what the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) has recorded as the most violent West Bank olive harvest season in its 20 years of records, Human Rights Watch said today.
title: Israeli authorities arrest West Bank activists protecting Palestinian farmers
